configuration.changes: Independent F25 copy. Remove top-level banks/loaders; add one read_params process and layer streams; move existing cyclic banks into engines, with ram_s2p LUTRAM and II1 local loading. Keep all inference arithmetic, precisions, online padding, AXI bundles and two frames. C simulations may overlap F89; hardware synthesis waits for completed F26.
configuration.conclusion: Select only measured exact, resource-feasible behavior and expose every missed WS2 target; verify chosen local-loader architecture with a new two-frame RTL experiment before claiming dataflow correctness.

estimates.basis: F25 measured 37682 compute-region LUT, 32294 outside LUT and1056904 cycles. Remove roughly14000 bank-port mux LUT and four of five roughly2500-LUT converter copies; budget7000 LUT inside dataflow for one converter, layer loaders, FIFO/routing and3500 outside for preserved AXI/control. Three depth16 ten-bit parameter FIFOs add480 bits in LUTRAM, no BRAM/URAM. MAC allocation324/128/50 unchanged. Compute lower bound65025*16=1040400; allow about11600 cycles for startup, parameter load and drain. Conv1 needs5248 parameters; downstream streams load before pixel use. Attribution moves under DATAFLOW, so total LUT is the meaningful area check.

configuration.interpretation: Compare estimates with actual total/dataflow/outside LUT and report the new read_params/local-load modules. Check all fold II1, cycle bound<=1067473.04, clock<=2.377ns, unchanged border MSE and disappearance of weight-related HLS200-1449. Stream counts must be exact on each repeated invocation; C simulation cannot prove finite-FIFO progress.
configuration.name: local_streamed_params_T16
configuration.purpose: WS2 ownership experiment: one parameter AXI-reading process inside DATAFLOW quantizes each of 8032 weights and97 biases once, then sends three distinct streams of5248/2080/801 values. Each engine loads its private cyclic simple-dual-port bank and biases before reading pixels. Hypothesize that shared caller/consumer bank-port multiplexers, duplicated converters and weight-related HLS200-1449 warnings disappear, reducing total LUT as well as outside-LUT attribution. Separate per-layer streams prevent interleaved parameter/pixel deadlock.
